lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ع/د   w–ʿ–d promise, pledge, to promise
; threat, to threaten; to make an appointment; to come to an understanding.

Of this root, 11 forms occur 151 times in the Qur’an:
وَعَدَ waʿada 43 times; وُعِدَ wuʿida 27 times; تُوعِدُ tūʿid 1 time; وَاعَدَ wāʿada 4 times; تَوَاعَدَ tawāʿada 1 time; وَعْدٌ waʿd 49 times; وَعِيدٌ waʿıd 6 times; مَوْعِدٌ mawʿid 12 times; مَوْعِدَةٌ mawʿidatun 1 time; مَوْعُودٌ mawʿūd 1 time and مِيعَادٌ mıʿād 6 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
وَاعَدَ wāʿada [v. III, trans.]

1 to make promises to, to reach understanding with

(2:235) وَلَكِنْ لاَ تُوَاعِدُوهُنَّ سِرًّا but do not make agreements with them in secrecy

2 to appoint something for someone

(2:51) وَإِذْ وَاعَدْنَا مُوسَى أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً and when We appointed for Moses forty nights

3 to exchange pledges with, to make a covenant with

(20:80) قَدْ أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَاعَدْنَاكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّورِ الأَيْمَنَ We rescued you from your enemies and We made a covenant with you on the right‐hand side of the mountain.

entries.label: وَاعَدَ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَاعَدَ wāʿada [v. III, trans.]

1 to make promises to, to reach understanding with

(2:235) وَلَكِنْ لاَ تُوَاعِدُوهُنَّ سِرًّا but do not make agreements with them in secrecy

2 to appoint something for someone

(2:51) وَإِذْ وَاعَدْنَا مُوسَى أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً and when We appointed for Moses forty nights

3 to exchange pledges with, to make a covenant with

(20:80) قَدْ أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَاعَدْنَاكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّورِ الأَيْمَنَ We rescued you from your enemies and We made a covenant with you on the right‐hand side of the mountain.

entries.label: تَوَاعَدَ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَوَاعَدَ tawāʿada [v. VI, intrans.] to agree upon an appointment with one another

(8:42) وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدْتُمْ لاَخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى الْمِيعَادِ had you made an appointment together [to fight/meet], you would surely have differed [in keeping the time of, or in finding the place of] the appointment.

entries.label: تُوعِدُ
entries.definitionHtml:
تُوعِدُ tūʿid [imperf. of v. IV أَوْعَدَ ʾawʿada, trans.] to threaten

(7:86) وَلاَ تَقْعُدُوا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوعِدُونَ and do not sit in every pathway, threatening [wayfarers].

entries.label: مَوْعُودٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَوْعُودٌ mawʿūd [pass. part.] that which is agreed upon, promised *

(85:2) وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ by the promised Day, the inevitable Day.

entries.label: مَوْعِدٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَوْعِدٌ mawʿid I [v. n./n.]

1 appointment, appointed time, scheduled meeting; tryst

(20:59) مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ your appointment is on the feast day

2 a promise

(20:87) مَا أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا We did not break our word to you of our own accord II [n. of place] appointed place, promised destination

(11:17) وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهِ مِنَ الأَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ as for those of the groups who deny it [its truth], the Fire is their promised place.

entries.label: مَوْعِدَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَوْعِدَةٌ mawʿidatun [n.] a solemn promise

(9:114) وَمَا كَانَ اسْتِغْفَارُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لأَِبِيهِ إِلاَّ عَنْ مَوْعِدَةٍ وَعَدَهَا إِيَّاهُ Abraham’s seeking forgiveness [from God] for his father was only because of a promise he [his father] had made to him.

entries.label: مِيعَادٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مِيعَادٌ mıʿād I [v. n.; n.] a promise

(39:20) لاَ يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ God does not fail the promise II [n. of place; n. of time] place or time of an appointment

(8:42) لاَخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى الْمِيعَادِ you would surely have differed [in keeping the time of, or in finding the place of], the appointment.

entries.label: وَعَدَ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَعَدَ waʿada i [v. trans.]

1 to promise

(5:9) وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ God has promised those who believe and do good deeds that they will have forgiveness and a rich reward

2 to threaten

(11:32) فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا so bring us that with which you are threatening us.

entries.label: وَعِيدٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَعِيدٌ waʿıd [v. n./n.]

1 warning

(14:14) ذَلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ this reward is for those who are in awe of meeting Me, and who heed My warnings

2 promised retribution, punishment

(50:14) كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ all [of these peoples] rejected the prophets, so my promised punishment fell due; *

(50:20) يَوْم الوَعِيد the Day of Retribution [lit. the Day of Threatening].

entries.label: وَعْدٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَعْدٌ waʿd [n./v. n.]

1 promise

(28:61) وَعَدْنَاهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا We made him a good promise

2 threat

(22:47) وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَنْ يُخْلِفَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ they will challenge you to hasten the punishment: God will not fail in His threat.

entries.label: وُعِدَ
entries.definitionHtml:
وُعِدَ wuʿida [pass. v.]

1 to be promised

(47:15) الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ the Garden the pious are promised

2 to be threatened

(51:60) يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ the Day with which they are threatened.
